title: Phase transition of Schott's statistic for high-dimensional heavy-tailed data
summary: Consider Schott's statistic (Schott, 2005) defined as the squared Frobenius norm of the sample correlation matrix for data from $α$-regularly varying populations. We investigate its asymptotic distribution in a general framework characterized by data dimension p, sample size n, and regularly varying coefficients $α$. In particular, we identify a phase transition phenomenon in the asymptotic behavior.
